note: Synthetic eval set (handoff 9.3). 20 seeds, 20 rewrites (rewriteOf = seed id; 5 in Spanish), 20 unrelated.

seeds.text: A study app that turns lecture notes into short quizzes and uses spaced repetition to resurface facts you missed.
A bike commute planner that scores routes by air quality sensor data instead of distance.
Take a photo of your pantry and get three dinner recipes that use only what you already have.
Shared online focus rooms with lo-fi music where friends see each other's study timers and take synced breaks.
A campus lost and found where an image model matches found item photos to lost item reports.
A capture the flag practice site with tiered hints that explain the concept behind each exploit.
A period tracker that keeps all data encrypted on the phone and makes predictions locally.
Pairs first year computer science students with seniors who aced the same classes for short mentoring calls.
A browser extension that summarizes long terms of service and highlights clauses about selling your data.
An app that splits shared grocery bills among roommates by scanning the receipt and assigning items.
A plant care app that reads soil moisture from a cheap sensor and texts you when to water.
A volunteer scheduling tool for food banks that fills shifts automatically and sends reminders.
A sign language learning game that uses the phone camera to check if your hand shapes are correct.
A tool that turns a GitHub repository into an interactive onboarding tour for new contributors.
An accessibility checker that scans a website and suggests fixes for color contrast and missing alt text.
A carpool matcher for commuters at the same office that splits fuel costs fairly.
A thrift marketplace for students to sell used textbooks and dorm furniture at the end of each semester.
A habit tracker where a small group of friends keeps each other accountable with daily check-ins.
An app that warns hikers about trail closures and weather changes using park service alerts.
A meal planning assistant for people with food allergies that filters recipes and builds a shopping list.

rewrites.text: Students upload class notes and the app quizzes them, bringing back the facts they keep getting wrong with spaced repetition.
Route planning for cyclists that picks the path with the cleanest air using live pollution sensors.
Snap your kitchen shelves and receive dinner ideas made from ingredients you have on hand.
Virtual study rooms with chill background music, visible timers for every friend, and breaks everyone takes together.
Lost something on campus? Found items are photographed and matched to your report by image recognition.
Practice CTF challenges where each hint level teaches the underlying vulnerability rather than giving the answer.
Menstrual cycle tracking with on-device predictions and encryption so nothing leaves your phone.
Match freshmen in CS with upperclassmen who did well in the same courses for quick mentor chats.
Extension that shortens terms of service pages and flags any clause about sharing or selling personal data.
Scan a grocery receipt and split each item between roommates so everyone pays their share.
A soil moisture sensor tells the app when your plants are dry and you get a text to water them.
Food bank shift planner that assigns volunteers on its own and reminds them before each shift.
Learn to sign through a game where the camera checks your handshapes in real time.
Generate a guided walkthrough of a codebase from its GitHub repo so new contributors get up to speed.
Scan any site for accessibility problems like low contrast and images without alt text, with suggested fixes.
Una aplicacion para compartir coche entre companeros de la misma oficina que divide el gasto de gasolina.
Mercado de segunda mano para estudiantes que venden libros de texto y muebles al final del semestre.
Un registro de habitos donde un grupo de amigos se motiva con controles diarios.
Aplicacion que avisa a los excursionistas sobre senderos cerrados y cambios de clima con alertas del parque.
Asistente de planificacion de comidas para personas con alergias que filtra recetas y crea la lista de compras.
